from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, sys, traceback

from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import validate_request, validate_result
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_record import normalized_run_files

TASK="A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2"
REQ=Path("control/model_execution/direct_requests")/(TASK+".json")
RES=Path("control/model_execution/direct_results")/(TASK+".json")

def sha_text(s:str)->str:
    return hashlib.sha256(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

stage="load"
try:
    request=json.loads(REQ.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    result=json.loads(RES.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    stage="prompt_hash"
    actual_prompt_sha=sha_text(request["prompt"])
    if actual_prompt_sha != request["input_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("PROMPT_HASH_MISMATCH expected="+request["input_sha256"]+" actual="+actual_prompt_sha)

    stage="final_hash"
    actual_final_sha=sha_text(result["final"])
    if actual_final_sha != result["completion_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("FINAL_HASH_MISMATCH expected="+result["completion_sha256"]+" actual="+actual_final_sha)

    stage="validate_request"
    validate_request(request)

    stage="validate_result"
    validate_result(request,result)

    stage="normalize"
    files=normalized_run_files(request,result)
    if set(files)!={"TASK.json","WORKER.json","COMPLETE.json","events.jsonl"}:
        raise ValueError("NORMALIZED_FILESET_MISMATCH")

    print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_DIAG")
    print("ERROR="+json.dumps({
        "stage":"PASS",
        "prompt_sha":actual_prompt_sha[:16],
        "final_sha":actual_final_sha[:16],
        "worker_route":result.get("worker_route_task_id"),
    },separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True))
    raise SystemExit(1)
except SystemExit:
    raise
except Exception as exc:
    print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_DIAG")
    print("ERROR="+json.dumps({
        "stage":stage,
        "error":type(exc).__name__,
        "detail":str(exc)[:220],
    },separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True))
    raise SystemExit(1)
